name: dev-digest-ai-latest
description: Claude Code plugins for spec-driven development: a multi-agent SDD harness, shared paved-path engineering skills, architecture review and research. Latest channel: every plugin and version as soon as it is merged.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Architecture reviewer agent: checks a change against the repository's own architecture docs and the engineering-paved-path architecture skills, with verified rule-based findings.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared technical skills for the paved path: React, testing, Next.js, Fastify, architecture, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Zod, TypeScript, security and Mermaid, plus a map from files to skills.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent that answers one concrete question with evidence from the repository, official docs, changelogs and issues.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development harness: spec, plan, test, implementation and verification agents, an end-to-end /sdd-run orchestrator, run retrospectives and engineering insights.
